status.custom_offline: Custom watch: {channel} is offline, waiting for the stream
status.idle: No drops to mine (check your priority settings and account links)
status.no_stream: There are campaigns to mine but no suitable stream right now, waiting

log.session_invalid: Session is no longer valid, you need to log in again.
log.discovery: Discovery: scanned {streams} drop-enabled streams, found {campaigns} campaigns ({offline} currently offline)
log.campaigns_updated: Campaigns updated: {total} campaigns, {active} active, {linked} account-linked, {minable} minable
log.inventory_fixed: ✔ Inventory check: {count} drops corrected to claimed ({names})
log.history_imported: Reward history: {count} rewards imported from your Twitch inventory
log.channel_picked: Picked {channel} out of {count} candidate channels (campaign verified on this channel)
log.channel_none: None of the {count} candidate channels offers this campaign
log.no_stream: No suitable stream: {game} — retrying in {minutes} min
log.watch_failed: Could not send the watch signal ({channel})
log.check_not_listed_early: not in the inventory yet ({minutes} min, normal in the first minutes)
log.check_not_listed: not in the inventory yet ({minutes} min)
log.tick_custom: ⏱ watching {who} (no active drop on this stream)
log.tick_waiting: ⏱ watching {who} — waiting for drop info ({minutes} min)
log.stalled: No drop progress on {channel} for {minutes} minutes, switching channel.
log.update_available: A new version is available: v{version}

error.device_code: Could not get a login code: {detail}
error.token_invalid: The received token could not be validated
error.gql_rejected: Twitch rejected the query (PersistedQueryNotFound / service error). The Twitch API may have changed.

tray.hidden_hint: Still running in the background. Click the tray icon to open it.

ui.server_down: Cannot reach the app — is it running?
ui.loading_hint: The first scan checks thousands of streams for drops and can take a few seconds.
ui.update_banner: A new version (v{version}) is available. You are using v{current}.
ui.switch_channel_tip: Exclude this channel for 30 min and switch to another one
ui.login_steps:
1) Click the button below (or go to twitch.tv/activate)
2) Log in with your Twitch account and confirm this code:
ui.login_expires: The code expires in {time} and is then renewed automatically. This page updates by itself once you confirm.
ui.extra_drops: Other drops progressing on this stream at the same time:
ui.no_drop_here: No active drop progress on this stream.
ui.acl_all: Valid on every channel streaming the game with drops enabled
ui.offline_tip: The streamer(s) offering this campaign are not live right now. It will be watched automatically once they go live.
ui.not_achievable: The remaining time may not be enough before the drop ends
ui.pinned_help: Added with ☆ on the Drops tab. The first drop in the list is mined first. A drop leaves the list once claimed.
ui.game_priority_help: After priority drops, games are mined in this order. Within the same rank, the campaign ending soonest comes first.
ui.no_pinned: No priority drops yet. Add some with ☆ on the Drops tab.
ui.no_game_priority: No game priority — all games are sorted by end date.
ui.mode_first: My picks first, then every other drop
ui.mode_only: Only the games / drops I picked
ui.opt_custom_fallback: Keep mining drops while the custom-watch streamer is offline
ui.opt_allow_unlinked: Also watch campaigns whose game account is not linked
ui.opt_notifications: Show notifications (reward claimed, login required, new version)
ui.opt_check_updates: Check for new versions on GitHub
ui.link_help: Most game rewards require your game account to be linked to Twitch. If it is not, the reward cannot be claimed even when the time is complete.
ui.excluded_help: Campaigns of these games are not watched (unless a drop is prioritized).
ui.custom_help: Watches the streamer you choose for the time you set (time only counts while the stream is live). The list is processed in order and custom watch takes precedence over drop mining. If the streamer plays a game with drops, drop progress is earned too.
ui.list_empty: The list is empty. Add a streamer above.
ui.hist_empty: No rewards yet. Claimed rewards appear here and are kept between sessions.
ui.hist_imported_tip: Imported from your Twitch inventory (claimed before this app, or on another device). Only the latest claim time is known.
